mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC <0.05 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% triggers bearish sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% but 20d returns remain non-negative, or t-test p-value >0.05 for negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both increase from prior month
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise, or IC <0.03 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates signal higher policy costs, depressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.2% in 1 month and in monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises in tightening cycle but 20d returns are positive, or IC >0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Stronger supply growth (INDPRO) indicates increased production capacity, reducing supply-side bottlenecks and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but 60d returns not significantly positive, or IC <0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 140k but 5d returns are non-positive, or p-value >0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rise >5% from prior month
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise, or IC <0.03 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion, rapid growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals peak momentum, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST rise >10% from prior month in late-cycle demand expansion regime
failure_condition: 60d returns remain non-negative despite GDPC1 and HOUST rising >10% in late-cycle demand expansion regime, or IC >0.05 over 2-year window.
